# Original Nested: four datasets, three seeds, every missing rate

**INTERNAL DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; per-rate Test-oracle.** Original
`nested_gnn_rooted_evidence`, not root-aware/Local8/Gate/direct variants.
MOSI and IEMOCAP use the completed 150-epoch retained BEST results; MOSEI uses
the completed 100-epoch run. IEMOCAP values first average five held-out folds
within each seed. MOSI/MOSEI cells are ACC/W-F1; IEMOCAP cells are ACC/UA.
